name: chlorzoxazone
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Chlorzoxazone is indicated as an adjunct to rest, physical therapy, and other measures for the relief of discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions. The mode of action of this drug has not been clearly identified, but may be related to its sedative properties. Chlorzoxazone does not directly relax tense skeletal muscles in man.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS Chlorzoxazone is contraindicated in patients with known intolerance to the drug.
